```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Google.Core;

public class GeminiChatCompletionClientTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void LogUsage_LogsInformation_WhenMetadataPresentAndInfoEnabled()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<GeminiChatCompletionClient>>();
        logger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(true);
        var mockClient = CreateMockClient(logger.Object);

        var chatMessageContents = new List<GeminiChatMessageContent>
        {
            new()
            {
                Metadata = new GeminiMetadata
                {
                    PromptTokenCount = 10,
                    CandidatesTokenCount = 20,
                    TotalTokenCount = 30
                }
            }
        };

        // Act
        mockClient.Object.LogUsage(chatMessageContents);

        // Assert
        logger.Verify(
            l => l.LogInformation(
                "Prompt tokens: {PromptTokens}. Completion tokens: {CompletionTokens}. Total tokens: {TotalTokens}.",
                10,
                20,
                30),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogUsage_LogsDebug_WhenMetadataNull()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<GeminiChatCompletionClient>>();
        var mockClient = CreateMockClient(logger.Object);

        var chatMessageContents = new List<GeminiChatMessageContent>
        {
            new() { Metadata = null! }
        };

        // Act
        mockClient.Object.LogUsage(chatMessageContents);

        // Assert
        logger.Verify(l => l.LogDebug("Token usage information unavailable."), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogUsage_LogsDebug_WhenTotalTokenCountZero()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<GeminiChatCompletionClient>>();
        var mockClient = CreateMockClient(logger.Object);

        var chatMessageContents = new List<GeminiChatMessageContent>
        {
            new()
            {
                Metadata = new GeminiMetadata { TotalTokenCount = 0 }
            }
        };

        // Act
        mockClient.Object.LogUsage(chatMessageContents);

        // Assert
        logger.Verify(l => l.LogDebug("Token usage information unavailable."), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogUsage_NoLogInformation_WhenInfoDisabled()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<GeminiChatCompletionClient>>();
        logger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(false);
        var mockClient = CreateMockClient(logger.Object);

        var chatMessageContents = new List<GeminiChatMessageContent>
        {
            new()
            {
                Metadata = new GeminiMetadata
                {
                    PromptTokenCount = 10,
                    CandidatesTokenCount = 20,
                    TotalTokenCount = 30
                }
            }
        };

        // Act
        mockClient.Object.LogUsage(chatMessageContents);

        // Assert
        logger.Verify(
            l => l.LogInformation(
                It.IsAny<string>(),
                It.IsAny<object[]>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>()),
            Times.Never);
    }

    private static Mock<GeminiChatCompletionClient> CreateMockClient(ILogger logger)
    {
        var mock = new Mock<GeminiChatCompletionClient>(
            Mock.Of<HttpClient>(),
            "test-model",
            "test-key",
            GoogleAIVersion.V1,
            logger)
        {
            CallBase = true
        };

        // Expose private LogUsage method via protected accessor
        mock.Protected()
            .Setup<List<GeminiChatMessageContent>>("ProcessChatResponse", ItExpr.IsAny<GeminiResponse>())
            .Returns((GeminiResponse _) => new List<GeminiChatMessageContent>());

        return mock;
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;

public class GeminiChatCompletionClientLogUsageTests
{
    private sealed class TestableGeminiChatCompletionClient : GeminiChatCompletionClient
    {
        public TestableGeminiChatCompletionClient(HttpClient httpClient, string modelId, string apiKey, GoogleAIVersion apiVersion, ILogger logger)
            : base(httpClient, modelId, apiKey, apiVersion, logger)
        {
        }

        public new void LogUsage(List<GeminiChatMessageContent> chatMessageContents) =>
            base.LogUsage(chatMessageContents);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogUsage_LogsInformation_WhenMetadataPresentAndInfoEnabled()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger>();
        logger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(true);
        var httpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>().Object;
        var client = new TestableGeminiChatCompletionClient(httpClient, "test-model", "test-key", GoogleAIVersion.V1, logger.Object);

        var chatMessageContents = new List<GeminiChatMessageContent>
        {
            new()
            {
                Metadata = new GeminiMetadata
                {
                    PromptTokenCount = 10,
                    CandidatesTokenCount = 20,
                    TotalTokenCount = 30
                }
            }
        };

        // Act
        client.LogUsage(chatMessageContents);

        // Assert
        logger.Verify(
            l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                0,
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => VerifyLogMessage(v, "Prompt tokens: 10. Completion tokens: 20. Total tokens: 30.")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogUsage_LogsDebug_WhenMetadataNull()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger>();
        var httpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>().Object;
        var client = new TestableGeminiChatCompletionClient(httpClient, "test-model", "test-key", GoogleAIVersion.V1, logger.Object);

        var chatMessageContents = new List<GeminiChatMessageContent>
        {
            new() { Metadata = null! }
        };

        // Act
        client.LogUsage(chatMessageContents);

        // Assert
        logger.Verify(
            l => l.LogDebug("Token usage information unavailable."),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogUsage_LogsDebug_WhenTotalTokenCountZero()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger>();
        var httpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>().Object;
        var client = new TestableGeminiChatCompletionClient(httpClient, "test-model", "test-key", GoogleAIVersion.V1, logger.Object);

        var chatMessageContents = new List<GeminiChatMessageContent>
        {
            new()
            {
                Metadata = new GeminiMetadata { TotalTokenCount = 0 }
            }
        };

        // Act
        client.LogUsage(chatMessageContents);

        // Assert
        logger.Verify(
            l => l.LogDebug("Token usage information unavailable."),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogUsage_NoLogInformation_WhenInfoDisabled()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger>();
        logger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(false);
        var httpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>().Object;
        var client = new TestableGeminiChatCompletionClient(httpClient, "test-model", "test-key", GoogleAIVersion.V1, logger.Object);

        var chatMessageContents = new List<GeminiChatMessageContent>
        {
            new()
            {
                Metadata = new GeminiMetadata
                {
                    PromptTokenCount = 10,
                    CandidatesTokenCount = 20,
                    TotalTokenCount = 30
                }
            }
        };

        // Act
        client.LogUsage(chatMessageContents);

        // Assert
        logger.Verify(
            l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Never);
    }

    private static bool VerifyLogMessage(object state, string expectedMessage)
    {
        var formatter = new TestLoggerFormatter();
        var message = formatter(state, null);
        return message == expectedMessage;
    }

    private sealed class TestLoggerFormatter : ITestLoggerFormatter
    {
        public string Format(object state, Exception? error) => state.ToString()!;
    }

    private interface ITestLoggerFormatter
    {
        string Format(object state, Exception? error);
    }
}
```

```csharp
        loggerFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(mockLogger.Object);

            CandidatesTokenCount = 20,
```
